text:
The data show **0.4 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021**, in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares. These patches were below the tool’s minimum event size, so they were not counted as loss events.

No other post-baseline loss is reported through 2025. The JRC reference also mapped no forest on the property in 2020, so the reported loss is not corroborated by that reference.
